settings.visualStyle: Guadalcanal 1942 historical reenactment, embedded jungle field-camera realism, dense wet tropical vegetation, mud, rain, shallow streams, foxholes and humid haze. Historically plausible U.S. Marine uniforms and equipment, muted green-brown wartime film palette, non-graphic combat, no modern objects.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Follow one fictional U.S. Marine scout through humid patrol movement, listening pause, stream crossing, sudden jungle contact, foxhole defense, rain, repositioning, exhaustion, dusk and dawn. No dialogue or narrator. One primary action and one camera movement per scene.
settings.customVisualStyle: Tactile Pacific jungle film look with moisture on lens edges, wet fabric, mud on boots, dripping leaves, brief flashes through foliage and realistic sound depth.

movie.plotDetails: Fictional composite U.S. Marine used as a continuity anchor; no claim of depicting a specific documented patrol.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create an immersive two-minute Guadalcanal jungle battlefield reenactment. Follow one fictional U.S. Marine scout through dense vegetation, a stream crossing, sudden contact, muddy foxholes, tropical rain, a brief exhausted pause, night tension and movement at dawn. No spoken dialogue or narrator. The jungle should obscure visibility and shape the entire visual experience. Combat stays non-graphic and spatially readable.
movie.storySummary: A Marine patrol moves through wet jungle and stops to listen before crossing a shallow stream. Sudden fire drives the unit into muddy cover. The lead Marine fights briefly, moves through ferns, checks the flank and spends a quiet moment exhausted in the rain. Dusk and darkness tighten the atmosphere before dawn returns and the patrol disappears deeper into the jungle.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP07 — Guadalcanal: Jungle Frontline

scenes.title: Humid Trail
scenes.description: A Marine patrol moves through a narrow trail beneath dense tropical canopy.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine pushes a broad wet leaf aside and continues with the patrol.
scenes.imageDescription: Guadalcanal 1942, dense tropical vegetation, U.S. Marines in wet historically plausible field gear, same scout with netted helmet, humid haze, mud on boots, muted green-brown film color.
scenes.videoPrompt: Handheld follow through foliage with leaves briefly crossing the lens. Audio: insects, wet leaves, boots in mud, gear, breathing. No speech.

scenes.title: Listen
scenes.description: The patrol freezes as jungle sound seems to change ahead.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine raises one hand, stops and listens without speaking.
scenes.imageDescription: Patrol still among vines and ferns, same scout alert, rifle low, deep green background with short sightlines.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still push-in through leaves toward the scout. Audio: insects soften, single bird call, distant water, breathing.

scenes.title: Stream Crossing
scenes.description: The patrol crosses a shallow rocky stream one soldier at a time.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine steps from a submerged rock to the far muddy bank and steadies himself on a root.
scenes.imageDescription: Shallow tropical stream, wet rocks, exposed roots, Marines crossing, same scout with damp trousers and rifle held high enough to stay dry.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low stepping shot following boots through water to the far bank. Audio: water splash, rocks, fabric, jungle ambience.

scenes.title: Jungle Erupts
scenes.description: A sudden exchange of fire breaks the quiet beyond the stream.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine dives behind roots and a fallen log as leaves shake from nearby impacts.
scenes.imageDescription: Dense jungle contact, wet leaves, fallen log, Marines diving to cover, muzzle flashes deeper in separated hostile vegetation, no gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: Abrupt drop from standing height to ground cover. Audio: sudden rifle fire, leaf impacts, hard breathing, no intelligible speech.

scenes.title: Mud Foxhole
scenes.description: The Marine reaches a shallow muddy fighting hole reinforced with wet logs.
scenes.actionDescription: He drops into the foxhole, plants one boot in mud and steadies his rifle over the edge.
scenes.imageDescription: Mud foxhole, wet log revetment, roots, rain-darkened soil, same Marine breathing hard, rifle offset from center.
scenes.videoPrompt: Drop into foxhole and settle at low height. Audio: mud, gear, nearby gunfire, insects beneath battle noise.

scenes.title: Short Return Fire
scenes.description: The Marine fires brief controlled bursts toward clearly separated hostile vegetation.
scenes.actionDescription: He fires briefly, lowers the weapon and changes his viewing angle.
scenes.imageDescription: Foxhole firing position, dense foliage ahead, short muzzle flash, same Marine mud-streaked, no enemy close in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low over-shoulder shot with a short firing beat, then lower weapon. Audio: brief rifle bursts, leaf movement, distant answering fire.

scenes.title: Rain Comes Hard
scenes.description: Tropical rain thickens over the position and changes the sound of the battlefield.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine stays low while rain runs from helmet brim and fills small puddles in the foxhole.
scenes.imageDescription: Heavy tropical rain, water dripping off netted helmet, muddy foxhole, rifle held close, no firing in this scene.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still close shot with rain dominating movement. Audio: heavy rain, water, breathing, distant muffled shots.

scenes.title: Move Through Ferns
scenes.description: A small group repositions through thick fern cover during a lull.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine crouch-runs behind two comrades toward a new patch of cover.
scenes.imageDescription: Waist-high ferns, wet leaves, mud spray, Marines moving in a short tactical relocation.
scenes.videoPrompt: Lateral handheld tracking through fern leaves. Audio: foliage, boots, gear, rain easing slightly.

scenes.title: Check the Stream Flank
scenes.description: The patrol studies the stream bank for movement while the firing fades.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine kneels beside wet roots and scans downstream without firing.
scenes.imageDescription: Jungle stream after rain, dripping roots, muddy bank, scout kneeling with rifle lowered, no visible enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan downstream from the scout’s position. Audio: water, rain drip, insects returning, distant gunfire.

scenes.title: Heat and Exhaustion
scenes.description: Humidity and combat fatigue become visible during a short pause.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine wipes rain and sweat from his eyes, takes a breath and checks a muddy sleeve.
scenes.imageDescription: Close tired Marine in muddy foxhole, sweat and rain, no active combat, rifle resting along log edge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle close push-in from muddy sleeve to exhausted face. Audio: breath, insects, drip, very distant artillery.

scenes.title: Patrol Moves Again
scenes.description: The section reforms and resumes movement along a narrow green corridor.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine falls into line and disappears beneath the canopy behind the others.
scenes.imageDescription: Same jungle trail now darker and wetter, patrol moving away, same scout with accumulated mud and wet gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear tracking shot through dense foliage. Audio: boots, wet leaves, insects, gear.

scenes.title: Dusk Under Canopy
scenes.description: Light drains quickly beneath the dense trees as the patrol keeps moving.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine advances carefully through blue-green dusk with rifle lowered but ready.
scenes.imageDescription: Dim tropical canopy, wet leaves reflecting low light, Marines moving cautiously, no visible enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward drift following the patrol. Audio: evening insects, occasional distant gunshot, breath.

scenes.title: Flashes Beyond the Trees
scenes.description: Distant flashes briefly illuminate the jungle during the night.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine remains low at the foxhole edge and watches without firing.
scenes.imageDescription: Dark jungle defensive position, rain-wet logs, distant flashes through trees, Marine silhouette low in cover.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static night shot with small exposure changes from distant flashes. Audio: insects, distant combat, occasional rain drip.

scenes.title: Wet Dawn
scenes.description: Morning returns with mist hanging between the trees after the night’s tension.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine steps onto the trail again with the same unit as mist lifts slowly.
scenes.imageDescription: Misty jungle dawn, wet foliage, exhausted Marines, same scout mud-streaked and damp, muted film color.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle side follow as the patrol restarts. Audio: morning birds, wet leaves, boots, distant battle.

scenes.title: Swallowed by the Jungle
scenes.description: The patrol becomes smaller until foliage hides the men completely.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine follows the patrol around a bend and disappears from view.
scenes.imageDescription: Long vertical jungle corridor, patrol receding beneath wet canopy, no victory gesture, dense foliage closing the frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Long rear closing shot, camera remains behind as foliage hides the patrol. Audio: insects, wet footsteps, distant war, restrained score tail.

characters.name: Marine Scout
characters.description: Anonymous U.S. Marine in historically plausible Guadalcanal-era field uniform and equipment, netted helmet, rifle and wet jungle gear.

continuity.continuityRules: Same face, helmet and field gear. Wetness and mud increase through rain/contact scenes and remain to the end.

props.personalProps: rifle, netted helmet, field pack, canteen
